source.collected_at: The Shelf, EAT_HACK 3 Oct 2026 (25 challenger brands)

methods.top1_share: votes for brand as #1 / voters; 95% CI Wilson (1927)
methods.top3_rate_given_tasted: times in top-3 / times tasted; Wilson CI
methods.bt_share: Bradley-Terry (1952) strength via MM (Hunter 2004) on rank-broken pairs (top1>top2>top3>other tasted), normalised to sum 1; prior 0.5 virtual games vs reference (assumption: shrinkage for n~50); CI = voter bootstrap B=100
methods.segments: screener ticks mapped to CONTRACT.md archetypes (SEGMENT_LABELS); only segments with n>=8 reported (assumption)
methods.ocean: Gosling, Rentfrow & Swann (2003) J. Res. Pers. 37:504-528; items 1-10 on 1-7; E=1,6R A=2R,7 C=3,8R ES=4R,9 O=5,10R; N=8-ES; rescaled to 0-1 as (x-1)/6 to match CONTRACT.md ocean 0-1

why_tags.taste: sensory: it tasted best (research/03 truth 6: sensory detectability / signature taste)
why_tags.trust: trust: brand/ingredients feel trustworthy (research/03 truth 5: borrowed trust)
why_tags.health_label: health: better ingredients/nutrition (research/03 truth 7; C->label reading, research/04)
why_tags.price_anchor: value: worth the price vs what's next to it (research/03 truth 4: reference-price anchoring)
why_tags.habit: habit: like what I already buy (research/03 truth 2/6: habit, sacred SKUs)
why_tags.novelty: novelty: new/different, want to try it (README: Openness -> food neophilia)
why_tags.mission_fit: fit: fits how I'd use it - lunch/gym/kids (README: mission)
why_tags.social_proof: social: heard of it / others rate it (research/03 truth 5)
why_tags.salience: pack: the pack caught my eye (research/04 notice model)
why_tags.gimmick_reactance: gimmick: claims feel like a gimmick (research/03 truth 8: reactance)
why_tags.loss_aversion: risk: too risky to waste money on (research/03 truth 1/7: loss aversion)
why_tags.price_too_high: price: too expensive for what it is (research/03 truth 7: 'too expensive' as cover)

positivity_check.why: humans can say 'no' even to their favourite; LLM personas rarely do (research/05-personas.md sec 6 item 6; arXiv 2609.13148 variance compression)
